about: A tool that turns a relational database into a ready-made web API.

prs.title: Filters on decimal columns work on PostgreSQL
prs.broken: On PostgreSQL, any filter on a decimal column, like price greater than 1.5, failed with an error. The value was sent as text, and PostgreSQL will not compare a number with text.
prs.changed: I made the filter turn decimal values into numbers before sending them, as it already did for whole numbers and true or false.
prs.matters: People can filter by prices, rates and other decimal values on PostgreSQL.
